description: One8x6-tile two-storey old Yangon tea-shop shophouse, peeling cream plaster over brick, green shutters, colonial balcony, simple tiled roof, open-front tea counter with kettles and a few plastic stools tucked WITHIN the building footprint, small robot tea machine and blank holo-menu fixture, bolted-on AC and conduits. Secular everyday neighbourhood architecture, not a palace or temple.

One8x8-tile single-storey neighbourhood convenience store, modest concrete structure, corrugated flat roof, glass shopfront and side wall, blank illuminated sign panel, visible fridge silhouettes, small scanner at door and patched cable runs. Everyday practical Yangon shop, no brands or writing.

One6x12-tile three-storey narrow Yangon shophouse, peeling pale plaster, old wooden shutters, modest iron balcony, ground-floor shop opening, roof water tank and AC units, tangled utility cable brackets and small blank cyberpunk sign fixtures. Both long side wall and short front wall visible, no attached neighbouring buildings.

One16x12-tile SIX-storey Yangon walk-up apartment block, weathered concrete, practical balconies, laundry rails WITHOUT laundry people, AC units, rooftop water tanks, key-on-string clips and small bolted-on data conduits, blank entrance scanner. Clearly six storeys, restrained cyan fixtures, secular practical architecture.

One3x2-tile mobile mohinga street-food stall, stainless fish-broth pots and bowls, small prep counter, worn corrugated canopy on poles, salvaged battery and small blank holo-menu fixture. Entire stall one isolated asset, no stools outside footprint, no steam effect, no vendor.

One2x2-tile compact ATM booth, small concrete and metal kiosk with canopy roof, recessed cash machine and blank screen, subtle cyan status fixture, conduit on side. One isolated utilitarian booth, no ground pavement or people.

One6x2-tile Yangon neighbourhood bus shelter, slim metal posts, weathered corrugated canopy, integrated bench, blank holo-timetable panel and small route sensor, modest cyan light strip. One connected shelter asset, no buses or surrounding road.

One empty8x6-tile tea-shop ROOM SHELL, floor and two48px-high BACK walls only, worn tiled floor, peeling cream plaster, exposed old brick patches, shuttered window, doorway, discreet terminal ports. No furniture, no counters, no kettles or stools; these will be separate props. No front walls.
